sentences.zh: 在太空探索的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来一直致力于帮助您了解世界，并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在订阅可享受特别优惠，网址是 nytimes.com/subscribe。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittroweff.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的娜塔莉·基特罗夫（Natalie Kittroweff）。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》（The Daily）。

sentences.en: The White House boarder's R.
sentences.zh: 白宫边境事务负责人（Border Czar）。

sentences.en: Tom Homan was recorded on an FBI surveillance tape in September 2024, accepting $50,000 in cash.
sentences.zh: 2024年9月，汤姆·霍曼（Tom Homan）在FBI的监控录音中被记录下收受了5万美元现金。

sentences.en: Did he keep that money or give it back?
sentences.zh: 他是留下了那笔钱，还是退回去了？

sentences.en: For the past few weeks, Trump officials have been asked repeatedly about an undercover FBI investigation of border czar Tom Homan.
sentences.zh: 过去几周，特朗普政府官员一再被问及FBI对边境事务负责人汤姆·霍曼的秘密调查。

sentences.en: What became of the $50,000 in cash that the FBI delivered to Mr. Homan?
sentences.zh: FBI交给霍曼先生的那5万美元现金后来怎么样了？

sentences.en: And consistently, they've sidestepped.
sentences.zh: 他们始终都在回避这个问题。

sentences.en: Did he accept that $50,000 or not?
sentences.zh: 他到底有没有收那5万美元？

sentences.en: George, I don't know what you're talking about.
sentences.zh: 乔治，我不知道你在说什么。

sentences.en: Did he accept $50,000 for what?
sentences.zh: 他收那5万美元是为了什么？

sentences.en: Or refuse to answer key questions.
sentences.zh: 或者拒绝回答关键问题。

sentences.en: Did the FBI get it back?
sentences.zh: FBI把钱追回来了吗？

sentences.en: Senator Whitehouse, you're welcome to talk to the FBI.
sentences.zh: 怀特豪斯参议员，欢迎你去和FBI谈谈。

sentences.en: About whether one of Trump's top immigration officials brazenly broke the law and what's being done about it.
sentences.zh: 关于特朗普的一位高级移民官员是否公然违法，以及对此采取了什么行动。

sentences.en: The White House and the president stand by Tom Homan 100% because he did absolutely nothing wrong.
sentences.zh: 白宫和总统百分之百支持汤姆·霍曼，因为他绝对没有做错任何事。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Devlin Barrett on the story behind those questions and why the Tom Homan scandal hasn't faded away.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事德夫林·巴雷特（Devlin Barrett）将讲述这些问题背后的故事，以及为什么汤姆·霍曼的丑闻至今仍未平息。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, October 15th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月15日，星期三。

sentences.en: Devlin, I've been watching this story of these allegations surrounding Tom Homan unfold over the past several weeks.
sentences.zh: 德夫林，过去几周我一直在关注围绕汤姆·霍曼的这些指控是如何展开的。

sentences.en: And as I've watched, I keep thinking about this interview I did with Homan on the show in June.
sentences.zh: 在关注的过程中，我不断想起六月份我在节目中对霍曼做的那次采访。

sentences.en: One thing that really stuck with me from that interview was just how uncompromising Homan was
sentences.zh: 那次采访中有一点让我印象深刻，那就是霍曼是多么的毫不妥协，

sentences.en: in the way he presented his view of the law and what should happen to people who break it, that they should be punished.
sentences.zh: 他阐述自己法律观的方式，以及他认为违法者应该受到什么样的惩罚。

sentences.en: And I want to just play you a little bit of tape about how he represented himself and that mission.
sentences.zh: 我想播放一小段录音，看看他是如何代表自己和那项使命的。

sentences.en: We're nice from laws, right?
sentences.zh: 我们是法律的拥护者，对吧？

sentences.en: We've got to enforce the laws.
sentences.zh: 我们必须执行法律。

sentences.en: Entering this country legal is a crime.
sentences.zh: 非法进入这个国家是一种犯罪。

sentences.en: We don't pick and choose what we enforce.
sentences.zh: 我们不会选择性地执行法律。

sentences.en: We're here to enforce the law.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里是为了执行法律。

sentences.en: And then recently, we got some new information about Homan.
sentences.zh: 最近，我们又得到了一些关于霍曼的新信息。

sentences.en: Tell us when you first learned about this story.
sentences.zh: 告诉我们你是什么时候第一次了解到这个故事的。

sentences.en: So I cover the Justice Department and the FBI.
sentences.zh: 我负责报道司法部和FBI。

sentences.en: And months ago, I had started hearing rumblings that there had been some kind of bribery investigation related to Tom Homan.
sentences.zh: 几个月前，我开始听到一些传闻，说有一项与汤姆·霍曼有关的贿赂调查。

sentences.en: But I couldn't quite figure out what it was about or where it was.
sentences.zh: 但我无法确定它到底是什么，或者发生在什么地方。

sentences.en: And for a while, it just was a puzzle I couldn't solve.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，这对我来说只是一个解不开的谜题。

sentences.en: You had a lot of other stories you were covering.
sentences.zh: 你当时还在报道很多其他新闻。

sentences.en: It's pretty busy at the DOJ and the FBI most days.
sentences.zh: 司法部和FBI大多数时候都很忙。

sentences.en: Then sometime in September, I got a little more information where someone knew some of the answers to these questions and said, you know, oh, you mean the case with a bag of cash?
sentences.zh: 后来在9月的某个时候，我得到了一些更多信息，有人知道这些问题的一些答案，他说，哦，你是说那个装现金袋子的案子吗？

sentences.en: Whoa, bag of cash.
sentences.zh: 哇，装现金的袋子。

sentences.en: It's a that's a pretty big tip.
sentences.zh: 那可是个相当大的线索。

sentences.en: Well, right.
sentences.zh: 嗯，没错。

sentences.en: That's not, you know, what you think of as like, let's call it regular business practice.
sentences.zh: 那可不是你认为的所谓常规商业行为。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's almost the stereotypical way that people think of corruption cases.
sentences.zh: 这几乎是人们心目中腐败案件的典型方式。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So from that point, I started putting more pieces together and figuring more things out.
sentences.zh: 所以从那时起，我开始把更多的碎片拼凑起来，弄清楚更多的事情。

sentences.en: I wasn't the only reporter chasing this.
sentences.zh: 我不是唯一一个追踪这个故事的记者。

sentences.en: MSNBC also figured it out.
sentences.zh: MSNBC也发现了这一点。

sentences.en: And so what I eventually came to understand was that there had been beginning really in 2023,
sentences.zh: 我最终了解到的是，从2023年开始，

sentences.en: 2023, but stretching all the way into this year, a really fascinating investigation that came to include Tom Homan.
sentences.zh: 2023年，一直持续到今年，有一项非常引人注目的调查，最终将汤姆·霍曼牵涉其中。

sentences.en: As it's been described to me by sources, if you go back to the spring of 2023, the FBI in Texas was conducting an undercover investigation related to a particular businessman.
sentences.zh: 据消息人士向我描述，如果你回到2023年春天，德克萨斯州的FBI正在对一名特定的商人进行秘密调查。

sentences.en: And the investigation, my sources were adamant, was not looking at Tom Homan at all.
sentences.zh: 我的消息人士坚称，这项调查根本没有针对汤姆·霍曼。

sentences.en: But in the course of that investigation, that businessman told the undercover agents that
sentences.zh: 但在调查过程中，那名商人告诉卧底特工，

sentences.en: if those agents were posing as businessmen looking for government contracts, if they were willing to pay Tom Homan a million dollars, he could steer government contracts to them.
sentences.zh: 如果这些特工伪装成寻求政府合同的商人，如果他们愿意付给汤姆·霍曼一百万美元，他就能为他们争取到政府合同。

sentences.en: So these agents weren't initially fishing for anything related to Tom Homan.
sentences.zh: 所以这些特工最初并不是在钓鱼搜集任何与汤姆·霍曼有关的东西。

sentences.en: They weren't looking at him at that time.
sentences.zh: 他们当时并没有盯着他。

sentences.en: My sources are adamant that no one had asked about Tom Homan.
sentences.zh: 我的消息人士坚称没有人问过关于汤姆·霍曼的事。

sentences.en: That was brought up unprompted.
sentences.zh: 那是他主动提出来的。

sentences.en: And Tom Homan just sort of wanders into the picture, wanders into the frame of what the
sentences.zh: 汤姆·霍曼就这样闯入了画面，闯入了FBI特工正在进行的调查框架中。

sentences.en: FBI agents are already doing.
sentences.zh: FBI特工正在做的事情。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Just to put us in time here, we're in 2023.
sentences.zh: 为了理清时间线，我们现在是在2023年。

sentences.en: We know Tom Homan as the former ICE director in the first Trump administration, this longtime border official.
sentences.zh: 我们知道汤姆·霍曼是特朗普第一任政府时期的前移民及海关执法局（ICE）局长，这位长期的边境官员。

sentences.en: He actually served in the Obama administration.
sentences.zh: 他实际上还在奥巴马政府任职过。

sentences.en: But he's not in government at this point, right?
sentences.zh: 但他现在不在政府任职，对吧？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He's just a private citizen and he runs a consulting business for companies that are seeking contracts.
sentences.zh: 他只是一个普通公民，为寻求合同的公司经营一家咨询公司。

sentences.en: So it's not completely out of the blue that he would have some interest in government contracts.
sentences.zh: 所以他会对政府合同感兴趣并不完全出人意料。

sentences.en: But again, he's not in government at that time.
sentences.zh: 但再说一次，他当时不在政府任职。

sentences.en: And he's known mostly as a former Trump official who is what they sometimes call a campaign surrogate.
sentences.zh: 他主要以特朗普前官员的身份而闻名，有时被称为竞选代理人。

sentences.en: He often would appear, you know, speaking publicly in support of another Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 他经常公开露面，支持特朗普再次执政。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of general expectation that if Trump wins re-election, Homan will rejoin the government.
sentences.zh: 人们普遍预期，如果特朗普赢得连任，霍曼将重返政府。

sentences.en: And in November of 2023, he out and out says it.
sentences.zh: 2023年11月，他直言不讳地说了出来。

sentences.en: He says, you know, I promised President Trump that if he goes back, I go back.
sentences.zh: 他说，我向特朗普总统承诺，如果他回去，我就回去。

sentences.en: And then he added to that, and I'm going to run the biggest deportation operation this country's ever seen.
sentences.zh: 然后他补充说，我将执行这个国家有史以来规模最大的驱逐行动。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He's widely seen as a likely member of a future Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 他被广泛视为未来特朗普政府的潜在成员。

sentences.en: He's saying he's going to be there.
sentences.zh: 他说他会加入。

sentences.en: And there's this sense that a lot of money is going to be thrown at the area that he's going to be involved in, in border enforcement.
sentences.zh: 人们有一种感觉，大量的资金将投入到他将参与的领域，即边境执法。

sentences.en: Well, right.
sentences.zh: 嗯，没错。

sentences.en: That whole time period, the Trump campaign is talking about deporting millions of people.
sentences.zh: 在那整个时期，特朗普竞选团队一直在谈论驱逐数百万人。

sentences.en: It is a very expensive prospect, so there is a natural expectation that there will be significant government contracts related to both border security work and deportation work.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常昂贵的计划，所以人们自然预期会有大量与边境安全工作和驱逐工作相关的政府合同。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So back to the investigation.
sentences.zh: 回到调查上来。

sentences.en: What happens next?
sentences.zh: 接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: So once that businessman just sort of proposes this notion that the undercover agents could pay Tom Homan to get government contracts, a series of conversations follow.
sentences.zh: 一旦那位商人提出卧底特工可以付钱给汤姆·霍曼以获取政府合同的想法，随后就进行了一系列对话。

sentences.en: This investigation goes on for a long time, but eventually a meeting is set up for September 20th, 2024.
sentences.zh: 这项调查持续了很长时间，但最终定在2024年9月20日进行了一次会面。

sentences.en: And at that meeting, my sources tell me the undercover agents bring $50,000 in cash.
sentences.zh: 在这次会面上，我的消息人士告诉我，卧底特工带来了5万美元现金。

sentences.en: And that cash is put in a takeout food bag, a bag from the chain Kava.
sentences.zh: 那些现金被装在一个外卖袋里，一个来自Kava连锁店的袋子。

sentences.en: So what has been described to me is at that meeting, Homan both accepts the cash and seems to convey that he's willing to help them get contracts in the future.
sentences.zh: 据向我描述，在这次会面上，霍曼既接受了现金，似乎也表达了他愿意在未来帮助他们获得合同。

sentences.en: Do we know exactly what he says, Devlin?
sentences.zh: 我们确切知道他说了什么吗，德夫林？

sentences.en: Do we have any specific information about that?
sentences.zh: 我们有关于此的具体信息吗？

sentences.en: We don't know exactly what he says, and that's obviously a big question in this whole process.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道他确切说了什么，这显然是整个过程中一个很大的疑问。

sentences.en: But we do know that the FBI agents made an audio recording of the meeting.
sentences.zh: 但我们确实知道FBI特工对这次会面进行了录音。

sentences.en: So somewhere in government files, there exists, I am told, an audio recording of this discussion.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，在政府档案的某个地方，存在着这次谈话的录音。

sentences.en: And what's been described to me is that Homan accepts the cash and leaves.
sentences.zh: 据向我描述，霍曼收下了现金并离开了。

sentences.en: And that's a great start to an investigation.
sentences.zh: 这对调查来说是一个很好的开始。

sentences.en: You've got a lot to work with there, right?
sentences.zh: 你有很多可以利用的东西，对吧？

sentences.en: Because the person you're investigating has taken the money and appears to have agreed to do things in exchange for the money.
sentences.zh: 因为你正在调查的人已经拿了钱，并且似乎已经同意为了钱做些事情。

sentences.en: But that's not really the end of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是调查的终点。

sentences.en: Why not?
sentences.zh: 为什么不呢？

sentences.en: For a couple of reasons.
sentences.zh: 原因有几个。

sentences.en: One, because there was no very specific act that he agreed to do in exchange for that money.
sentences.zh: 第一，因为他并没有同意为了那笔钱做任何非常具体的行为。

sentences.en: And two, it's important to remember, at the time he takes the money, Tom Homan is still not a government official.
sentences.zh: 第二，重要的是要记住，在他拿钱的时候，汤姆·霍曼仍然不是政府官员。

sentences.en: He certainly can't make the Biden administration, which was running the government at that time, award contracts.
sentences.zh: 他当然无法让当时执政的拜登政府授予合同。

sentences.en: So in the moment the cash is handed over, Homan really can't deliver even if he wants to.
sentences.zh: 所以当现金交到他手里时，即使霍曼想交付，他也真的做不到。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I guess the assumption here is that this is like a down payment for future services that he could potentially render, correct?
sentences.zh: 我想这里的假设是，这就像是他未来可能提供的服务的预付款，对吧？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The investigators thought of it as this is the start of the relationship.
sentences.zh: 调查人员认为这是关系的开始。

sentences.en: This is the start of the process.
sentences.zh: 这是过程的开始。

sentences.en: Devlin, does that help explain a question I've had about all this, which is $50,000 is a lot of money,
sentences.zh: 德夫林，这能解释我一直以来的一个疑问吗？那就是5万美元是一大笔钱，

sentences.en: but it also doesn't feel like enough for someone like Homan to do something this risky that could really jeopardize his career.
sentences.zh: 但对于像霍曼这样的人来说，做这种风险这么大、可能会危及他职业生涯的事情，似乎又不够多。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It wasn't necessarily that you give him this $50,000 and then he immediately starts doing things for you.
sentences.zh: 并不一定是你给了他这5万美元，然后他就会立即为你做事。

sentences.en: One source described it as, you know, they paid money to make a friend in a regular corruption investigation.
sentences.zh: 一位消息人士将其描述为，他们付钱是为了交个朋友。在常规的腐败调查中，

sentences.en: There would naturally be follow-up meetings, maybe follow-up payments.
sentences.zh: 自然会有后续的会面，也许还有后续的付款。

sentences.en: That's certainly a possibility in such an investigation.
sentences.zh: 在这样的调查中，这当然是一种可能性。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They're playing the long game here.
sentences.zh: 他们是在放长线钓大鱼。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: They have a very strong start to a case.
sentences.zh: 他们的案件有一个非常强有力的开端。

sentences.en: They have very good evidence and they have a very good basis to proceed with their investigation.
sentences.zh: 他们有非常好的证据，也有非常好的基础来推进他们的调查。

sentences.en: And then Trump wins the election.
sentences.zh: 然后特朗普赢得了选举。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And within days of Trump winning the election, the president-elect announces that Tom Homan will become his border czar.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普赢得选举后的几天内，当选总统宣布汤姆·霍曼将成为他的边境事务负责人。

sentences.en: And not many people know the ins and outs of the czar positions that government and White Houses sometimes announce.
sentences.zh: 没有多少人了解政府和白宫有时宣布的“负责人”（Czar）职位的内幕。

sentences.en: Yeah, I've always wondered, is that a real long-term position in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 是的，我一直很好奇，这在美国政府中是一个长期的正式职位吗，

sentences.en: government, czar?
sentences.zh: 负责人？

sentences.en: It's not something you're nominated for.
sentences.zh: 这不是一个需要提名的职位。

sentences.en: It's not something that the Senate confirms you for.
sentences.zh: 也不是一个需要参议院确认的职位。

sentences.en: Or it's very much sort of a point person for an administration on a particular subject.
sentences.zh: 它更多是政府在特定议题上的关键联络人。

sentences.en: But what matters in this instance is that because there's no Senate confirmation,
sentences.zh: 但在这个案例中重要的是，因为没有参议院的确认程序，

sentences.en: there's not the same kind of background check scrubbing that goes on for a czar position as there is for a cabinet official or a deputy cabinet official.
sentences.zh: 对于“负责人”职位，就不会像内阁官员或副内阁官员那样进行严格的背景调查。

sentences.en: And that's important in Homan's situation because there is this underlying outstanding case.
sentences.zh: 这在霍曼的情况下很重要，因为存在这个潜在的未决案件。

sentences.en: Are you saying basically that this might have been intentional, that the Trump administration might have nominated Homan to the czar position in order to avoid a background check?
sentences.zh: 你是说基本上这可能是故意的，特朗普政府提名霍曼担任负责人职位是为了规避背景调查吗？

sentences.en: It's really unclear.
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚。

sentences.en: But we do know, however, that during the transition, after Trump is elected but before he is sworn into office,
sentences.zh: 但我们确实知道，在过渡期间，也就是特朗普当选之后、宣誓就职之前，

sentences.en: federal law enforcement officials notify and essentially warn the incoming administration that this investigation exists into Tom Homan.
sentences.zh: 联邦执法官员通知并实质上警告了即将上任的政府，称针对汤姆·霍曼的调查正在进行中。

sentences.en: And the Trump Justice Department then does inherit this investigation.
sentences.zh: 随后，特朗普政府的司法部接手了这项调查。

sentences.en: Walk us through what they do with it.
sentences.zh: 请为我们梳理一下他们是如何处理此事的。

sentences.en: The short answer is they don't do much of anything with it.
sentences.zh: 简短的回答是，他们几乎什么都没做。

sentences.en: The senior officials of that administration look at the case and they don't like it.
sentences.zh: 该政府的高级官员审视了此案，但他们并不喜欢它。

sentences.en: They're very skeptical that this is anything worth pursuing.
sentences.zh: 他们非常怀疑这是否值得继续追查。

sentences.en: And this case that the agents and investigators thought was a very solid case, a very promising start, it just gets closed.
sentences.zh: 而这起探员和调查人员认为非常扎实、开局非常有希望的案件，就这样被结案了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温纳卢。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的《Connections》谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的这些人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 请访问 nytimes.com/games，立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: So, Devlin, once this story breaks about the investigation and about the ending of the investigation, what happens?
sentences.zh: 那么，德夫林，一旦关于这项调查以及调查结束的消息传出，会发生什么？

sentences.en: How does the Trump administration respond?
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府是如何回应的？

sentences.en: Do they explain their decision to drop this case?
sentences.zh: 他们是否解释了放弃此案的决定？

sentences.en: So, when we asked the Justice Department to explain, you know, why was this case closed, the FBI Director, Kash Patel, and the Deputy Attorney General, Todd Blanche, said that,
sentences.zh: 所以，当我们要求司法部解释为什么要结案时，联邦调查局局长卡什·帕特尔和副总检察长托德·布兰奇表示，

sentences.en: you know, it was reviewed by agents and prosecutors.
sentences.zh: 你知道，该案已经过探员和检察官的审查。

sentences.en: And they said those agents and prosecutors found no credible evidence of any criminal wrongdoing.
sentences.zh: 他们说，那些探员和检察官没有发现任何刑事不当行为的可靠证据。

sentences.en: They basically called it a baseless investigation.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上称这是一项毫无根据的调查。

sentences.en: And that's why they say they closed it.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们所说的结案原因。

sentences.en: They don't mention the bag of cash specifically?
sentences.zh: 他们没有特别提到那袋现金吗？

sentences.en: They don't mention the bag of cash, and that becomes a real focal point of all the questions that follow about what the administration did here and why they did it.
sentences.zh: 他们没有提到那袋现金，而这成为了随后所有关于政府在此事中做了什么以及为何这么做的问题的真正焦点。

sentences.en: One of the first very public comments about all this is the White House Press Secretary, Carolyn Levitt.
sentences.zh: 关于这一切，最早的公开评论之一来自白宫新闻秘书卡罗琳·莱维特。

sentences.en: Does Holman have to return the $50,000?
sentences.zh: 霍曼必须退还那五万美元吗？

sentences.en: Well, Mr. Holman never took the $50,000 that you're referring to, so you should get your facts straight, number one.
sentences.zh: 嗯，霍曼先生从未拿过你提到的那五万美元，所以首先，你应该把事实搞清楚。

sentences.en: Denying that he took the money at all.
sentences.zh: 完全否认他拿了钱。

sentences.en: Well, hours after that, Tom, I want to give you a chance to address this article that came out over the weekend.
sentences.zh: 好吧，在那之后几个小时，汤姆，我想给你一个机会来回应周末发表的那篇文章。

sentences.en: Tom Holman goes on Fox News, and he's given an opportunity to just respond to the reporting, respond to these allegations.
sentences.zh: 汤姆·霍曼上了福克斯新闻，他有机会回应这篇报道，回应这些指控。

sentences.en: And his answer is very telling in one way, in that he never denies taking the money.
sentences.zh: 他的回答在某种程度上非常能说明问题，因为他从未否认拿钱。

sentences.en: Look, I did nothing criminal.
sentences.zh: 听着，我没有做任何犯罪的事。

sentences.en: I did nothing illegal.
sentences.zh: 我没有做任何违法的事。

sentences.en: And there's hit piece after hit piece after hit piece.
sentences.zh: 而且这简直是一篇接一篇的抹黑文章。

sentences.en: He repeats very emphatically that he didn't commit any crime.
sentences.zh: 他非常强调地重申他没有犯下任何罪行。

sentences.en: And I'm glad the FBI and DOJ came out and said, and, you know, said that nothing illegal happened and nothing, you know, no criminal activity.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴联邦调查局和司法部站出来说，你知道，说没有发生任何违法的事情，也没有任何刑事活动。

sentences.en: Yeah, suddenly we're talking not about whether this happened or not, but about whether it was legal.
sentences.zh: 是的，突然之间我们讨论的不再是这件事是否发生，而是它是否合法。

sentences.en: And obviously those two things are very different.
sentences.zh: 显然这两者是非常不同的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so the administration ends up getting very adamant about the point that Holman makes in his interview on this, which is just to say there was no crime here.
sentences.zh: 因此，政府最终对霍曼在采访中提出的观点变得非常坚定，那就是这里没有犯罪。

sentences.en: And that becomes a kind of mantra throughout the administration as the questions keep coming up.
sentences.zh: 随着问题的不断出现，这成为了整个政府的一种口头禅。

sentences.en: Do you know sitting here where we took the money?
sentences.zh: 你坐在这里知道我们是在哪里拿的钱吗？

sentences.en: All I know is that Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanche and FBI Director Patel said there was no case.
sentences.zh: 我只知道副总检察长托德·布兰奇和联邦调查局局长帕特尔说此案不成立。

sentences.en: Last week, there's a hearing before the Senate Judiciary Committee in which Attorney General Pam Bondi is very confrontational.
sentences.zh: 上周，参议院司法委员会举行了一场听证会，总检察长帕姆·邦迪在会上表现得非常有对抗性。

sentences.en: If you worked for me, you would have been fired.
sentences.zh: 如果你为我工作，你早就被解雇了。

sentences.en: She is adamant that no crime was committed.
sentences.zh: 她坚称没有犯下任何罪行。

sentences.en: And she basically goes on the attack and just criticizes the lawmakers who are even asking the question.
sentences.zh: 她基本上转而发起攻击，批评那些提出质疑的议员。

sentences.en: In the same vein, just this past weekend, the vice president, J.D.
sentences.zh: 同样，就在上周末，副总统J.D.万斯接受了美国广播公司乔治·斯蒂芬诺普洛斯的采访。

sentences.en: Vance, is interviewed by ABC's George Stephanopoulos.
sentences.zh: 他再次被问及汤姆·霍曼和那袋现金的事。

sentences.en: And he's asked again about Tom Holman and the bag of cash.
sentences.zh: 你是说他没有接受那五万美元吗？

sentences.en: Are you saying that he did not accept the $50,000?
sentences.zh: 万斯的回答与邦迪的非常相似。

sentences.en: Vance's answer is very similar to Bondi's.
sentences.zh: 问题是，他做了违法的事吗？

sentences.en: The question is, did he do something illegal?
sentences.zh: 绝对没有任何证据表明汤姆·霍曼曾经收受过任何非法贿赂，这就是他能在政府工作的原因。

sentences.en: And there's absolutely no evidence that Tom Holman has ever taken a bribe of anything illegal, which is why he's working in the administration.
sentences.zh: 他坚称没有犯罪，并再次攻击提问者。

sentences.en: He insists no crime was committed and, again, goes on the attack for even asking the question.
sentences.zh: 当然，本届政府在能够证明是否犯罪之前就放弃了调查。

sentences.en: Of course, this administration dropped the investigation before they could actually prove whether or not a crime was being committed.
sentences.zh: 那么，德夫林，你如何看待他们的论点？

sentences.en: So, Devlin, what do you make of their argument?
sentences.zh: 从政治层面来看，他们的论点很简单。

sentences.en: So, on a political level, their argument is very simple.
sentences.zh: 这是一场由上一届民主党政府发起的党派猎巫行动。

sentences.en: This was a partisan witch hunt generated by the last Democratic administration.
sentences.zh: 法律论点实际上要复杂一些。

sentences.en: The legal argument is actually a little more complicated.
sentences.zh: 它涉及很多方面。

sentences.en: And it touches on a lot of things.
sentences.zh: 首先，我想说并非司法部内部的每个人对这个案件的看法都完全一致。

sentences.en: First, I would just say not everyone inside the Justice Department has the exact same view about this case.
sentences.zh: 我交谈过的人非常坚定地认为这是一个非常强有力的案件，一个可以起诉、可以追究的案件。

sentences.en: I have talked to people who feel very strongly that it was a very strong case, a chargeable case, a pursuable case.
sentences.zh: 案件被撤销让这些人感到沮丧。

sentences.en: And it's frustrating to those people that the case was dropped.
sentences.zh: 我也和部门内部的其他一些人谈过，他们认为，看，这是一个很好的案件开端。

sentences.en: I have talked to other people inside the department who have made the argument, look, this was a great beginning of a case.
sentences.zh: 由于我们还没有完成调查，如果没有更多证据，它就不是一个出色的案件。

sentences.en: Since we had not finished the case, we had not finished the case, and it's not a terrific case without more evidence.
sentences.zh: 所以，即使在部门内部，对这件事也没有统一的看法。

sentences.en: So, there aren't universal views about this, even inside the department.
sentences.zh: 但它也，

sentences.en: But it also,
sentences.zh: 这个案件反映了一个长期存在的争议，即司法部是否过度使用和延伸了反腐败法，超出了其原本的意图。

sentences.en: this case speaks to what's really a long-running disagreement about whether or not the Justice Department is overusing and stretching corruption laws beyond what they were intended to do.
sentences.zh: 多年来，

sentences.en: And over a number of years,
sentences.zh: 最高法院基本上削弱了联邦反腐败法的使用方式，并一再向司法部发出信号，即法院中的保守派肯定认为司法部在许多情况下，

sentences.en: the Supreme Court has basically whittled away at how federal corruption laws can be used and has repeatedly sent a signal to the Justice Department that certainly the conservatives on the court believe that the Justice Department is,
sentences.zh: 滥用或过度使用反腐败法规来针对政治人物。

sentences.en: in many cases, misusing or overusing corruption statutes to go after politicians.
sentences.zh: 这意味着法律界内部对于什么才真正构成腐败，或者至少在法庭上证明腐败的门槛是什么，存在分歧。

sentences.en: Meaning there's a disagreement within the legal community about what actually constitutes corruption, or at least what's the threshold for proving it in court.
sentences.zh: 嗯，正是如此。

sentences.en: Well, exactly.
sentences.zh: 律师们争论这个案件的方式之一是，有一种叫做“利益流”腐败的概念，

sentences.en: And one of the ways that this case gets argued about among lawyers is there's something called stream-of-benefits corruption,
sentences.zh: 其论点是你不需要非常明确的“交换条件”。

sentences.en: which makes the argument that you don't need a very explicit quid pro quo.
sentences.zh: 你不需要非常明确地说，你给我多少钱，我就为你做什么事。

sentences.en: You don't need a very explicit, you give me X dollars and I will do Y for you.
sentences.zh: 像《黑道家族》那样。

sentences.en: Soprano style.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 你可以有一种腐败的利益流动关系，我为你做以下事情，比如给现金，作为交换，你为我做以下事情，

sentences.en: That what you can have is a sort of corrupt flow relationship where I do the following things for you, like cash, and you in exchange do the following things for me,
sentences.zh: 比如官方恩惠，比如获取合同。

sentences.en: like official favors, like getting contracts.
sentences.zh: 但法院必须相信它是明确的。

sentences.en: But the court has to believe that it's explicit.
sentences.zh: 不能只是一系列模糊的行为。

sentences.en: It can't just be a vague set of actions.
sentences.zh: 这就是如何起诉这类案件的论点。

sentences.en: That's the argument for how you could charge a case like this.
sentences.zh: 所以这里显然有很多悬而未决的法律问题。

sentences.en: So there are obviously a lot of open legal questions here.
sentences.zh: 也许联邦调查局手中的案件还不是一个板上钉钉的案子。

sentences.en: And maybe what the FBI had in its hands wasn't an open and shut case yet.
sentences.zh: 但霍曼作为一名执法人员，作为本届政府移民政策的首席发言人，拿了这笔钱确实引发了各种各样的问题。

sentences.en: But Homan taking this money as a lawman, as the chief spokesman of this administration's immigration policy, it does raise all sorts of questions.
sentences.zh: 而政府没有跟进调查也引发了质疑。

sentences.en: And the administration not following up also raises questions.
sentences.zh: 我想知道的是，德夫林，目前围绕特朗普政府的类似丑闻太多了，

sentences.en: I guess what I'm wondering, Devlin, is there's been so many similar scandals swirling around the Trump administration at this point,
sentences.zh: 从加密货币到免费飞机，各种腐败指控层出不穷。

sentences.en: allegations of corruption from crypto to the free airplane.
sentences.zh: 其中许多在我们要面对的日常新闻轰炸中已经逐渐淡出人们的视野。

sentences.en: A lot of those have kind of faded away in the fire hose of news that we are all experiencing on a day-to-day basis.
sentences.zh: 但这一起似乎比特朗普的新闻周期更持久。

sentences.en: But this one has kind of outlived the Trump news cycle.
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 我是说，看，作为一名报道司法部和联邦调查局的记者，我可以告诉你，有很多腐败案件很难追踪，很难解释，

sentences.en: I mean, look, as someone who covers the Justice Department and the FBI, I will tell you that there are many corruption cases that are hard to follow, hard to explain,
sentences.zh: 很难理清和拆解。

sentences.en: hard to just unravel and unpack.
sentences.zh: 加密货币不是一件容易解释的事情。

sentences.en: Crypto isn't an easy thing to explain.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 你知道什么是容易解释的吗？

sentences.en: You know what is easy to explain?
sentences.zh: 我有一袋现金。

sentences.en: I have a bag full of cash.
sentences.zh: 这很简单。

sentences.en: That's pretty simple.
sentences.zh: 他为什么要拿一袋现金？

sentences.en: Why did he take a bag of cash?
sentences.zh: 他用这些现金做了什么？

sentences.en: What did he do with the cash?
sentences.zh: 除了这袋现金很简单之外，我们从报道中得知，某处存在一份录音带。

sentences.en: And in addition to how simple a bag of cash is, we know from the reporting that an audio tape exists somewhere.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 那份录音带可能会被公开。

sentences.en: And that tape could be released.
sentences.zh: 人们可能会开始要求公开它。

sentences.en: People could start demanding its release.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你花点时间想想杰弗里·爱泼斯坦案，显然汤姆·霍曼案不是杰弗里·爱泼斯坦案。

sentences.en: So, if you think for a minute about the Jeffrey Epstein case, obviously the Tom Homan case is not the Jeffrey Epstein case.
sentences.zh: 爱泼斯坦案是一个完全不同类型的案件，有着完全不同的历史。

sentences.en: Epstein is a completely different type of case with a completely different history.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 但要求公开汤姆·霍曼录音带的呼声，在某些方面与要求公开爱泼斯坦文件的呼声非常相似，因为这是一个简单、直接的问题。

sentences.en: But the demand to release the Tom Homan tape is in some ways very similar to the demands to release the Epstein files because it's a simple, straightforward question.
sentences.zh: 当你被告知不行时，这引出了一个问题：为什么答案是不行？

sentences.en: And it's sort of when you are told no, it begs the question, well, why is the answer no?
sentences.zh: 我可以问一下，我们知道那五万美元的钱去哪了吗？

sentences.en: Can I just ask, do we know what happened to the money, the $50,000?
sentences.zh: 我们真的不知道。

sentences.en: We really don't.
sentences.zh: 自最初报道以来，你所看到的大部分内容都是人们试图找出那个问题的答案，

sentences.en: A lot of what you've seen since the initial reporting is people trying to figure out the answer to that question,
sentences.zh: 但政府确实不会告诉我们，而霍曼到目前为止也没有告诉我们。

sentences.en: but the administration really won't tell us and Homan so far hasn't told us.
sentences.zh: 所以，案件可能已经死了，但我认为人们想要知道那个问题答案的愿望并没有死。

sentences.en: So, the case may be dead, but I think what hasn't died is people's desire to know the answer to that question.
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为在可预见的未来，无论汤姆·霍曼走到哪里，他都会被问到这个问题。

sentences.en: So, I think for the foreseeable future, wherever Tom Homan goes, he's going to be asked that question.
sentences.zh: 你用那些钱做了什么？

sentences.en: What did you do with the money?
sentences.zh: 好吧，德夫林，非常感谢你来到节目中。

sentences.en: Well, Devlin, thanks so much for coming on the show.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: Thanks for happening.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 周二，特朗普总统宣布，美国在委内瑞拉海岸附近的一艘船上击毙了六名男子，这是自九月以来加勒比海已知的第五次针对船只的打击行动。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, President Trump announced that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他说这些人一直在运送毒品，但没有提供任何证据来支持这一说法。

sentences.en: had killed six men aboard a boat off the coast of Venezuela, the fifth known strike on a boat in the Caribbean Sea since September.
sentences.zh: 虽然他发布了袭击视频，

sentences.en: He said the men had been transporting drugs but provided no evidence to support that claim.
sentences.zh: 但总统没有提供关于嫌疑人国籍的任何细节，也没有说明他们属于任何特定的犯罪集团。

sentences.en: And while he posted a video of the attack,
